with_model_outputs.label: End-of-episode D1 after a reward, policy leaning a2
with_model_outputs.explanation: Fires only at D1 (none at GO or D2), only when the reward input is 1 (previous trial rewarded), and only in the last ~10 trials of the 100-trial episode: none before trial 80, rate jumps from ~2% at trial 86 to ~75% from trial 92 on, falling slightly at trials 98-99. Correspondingly it fires only when the value head is low (<5.2, the end-of-episode regime). It is also specific to the a2 side: 9461 of 9462 activations are on trials where the agent goes on to choose a2, and the D1 policy logit (a1 - a2) sits in a moderate a2-favouring band (about -4.4 to -1.5). The recorded predicate uses only observed/model-computed quantities (D1, reward input, episode trial, D1 policy logit < -1.2), dev F1 0.84; swapping the logit for the upcoming action == 2 (the agent own choice) gives F1 0.79. Does not fire after unrewarded trials, on a1-leaning trials, or earlier in the episode. Example windows suggest magnitude rises over runs of consecutive rewarded a2 trials, but I did not check that systematically.

issues: The D1-only, in_rew==1 and late-episode claims all hold: zero activations at GO/D2 and zero before trial 80, on both dev and test. The value < 5.2 and choice-band claims also hold.

The predicate leaves out a hard condition, which is a systematic gap. The feature NEVER fires when the reward just shown came from S1 (prev_state==1), and it never fires after an a1 choice (prev_action==1), even when that a1 choice reached S2 rarely and was rewarded. On dev, D1 & in_rew==1 & prev_state==1 gives 0 of 96584 steps active. D1 & in_rew==1 & ep_trial>=90 & prev_action==1 & prev_state==2 gives 0 of 1088. On test, the late D1 rewarded steps with prev_state==1 or prev_action==1 give 0 of 11083 active.

1040 of the original predicate's ~2580 dev false positives are rewarded-from-S1 D1 steps with an a2-leaning logit (e.g. after a rare a2->S1 reward). The feature is silent on every one of them. So 'policy leaning a2' is a correlate: what the feature tracks is the observed history 'last trial was a2 -> S2 and rewarded'.

The label 'after a reward, policy leaning a2' overclaims generality. It is specifically after a reward collected at S2 via a2. The prev_action==-1 recall comes only from rel -3 rows, where the previous trial is outside the window.

The adjustment changes no recall and only raises precision. Adding (prev_state != 1) & (prev_action != 1) moves test precision from 0.73 to 0.83 and F1 from 0.818 to 0.875. Recall stays the same and the remaining misses are scattered weak activations (3.4% of mass).
skeptic.revised_label: End-of-episode D1 right after a reward collected at S2 via a2 (common a2->S2 rewarded), with policy leaning a2

with_model_outputs.final_label: End-of-episode D1 right after a reward collected at S2 via a2 (common a2->S2 rewarded), with policy leaning a2

label: Last ~9 trials of the episode: D1 after a rewarded common a2->S2 trial (window start: rewarded D1 while belief favours S2); activation grows toward the episode end
explanation: Fires only at D1 in the last 10 trials of the episode (97% of mass at ep_trial 90-99), when the reward input is 1 and the previous trial was a2 reaching S2 (or unknown at window start), and the observed-history belief says S2 is the good state (belief < 0.5). The belief term replaces the banned policy-logit condition (precision 0.70 -> 0.83). Remaining misses are weak activations, mostly after rare-transition rewards; false positives are D1s matching the rule where the feature stays silent. Magnitude modulation not checked.

issues: False claim: 'remaining misses are mostly after rare-transition rewards'. At ep_trial >= 90, rewarded rare D1s (a1->S2 and a2->S1) never fire (test precision 0, recall 0). The misses are rewarded a2->S2 D1s where belief >= 0.5, window-start steps, and the 3% of mass at ep_trial 80-89.

Misleading belief claim: when the previous trial is in the window, belief < 0.5 adds nothing (rewarded a2->S2 at ep>=90: precision 0.810 without it, 0.813 with it). Belief only matters on window-start steps (precision 0.73, 16% of mass).

Systematic false positives at the onset: at ep_trial == 90, rewarded a2->S2 D1s have precision only 0.34. Activation ramps up over the last trials (e.g. 0.20 -> 0.41 -> 0.59 -> 0.73 -> 0.82 across one window), and at ep_trial >= 95 precision is 0.91. Starting the cutoff at 91 lifts test F1 0.856 -> 0.867.
The 'end of episode' core and the 'never at GO/D2, never with in_rew==0' parts hold. Upcoming a2 adds little (F1 0.856 -> 0.860 with action==2).
